name: Earthfall AP

stealth.note: @Check[Astronomy Lore|dc:42] (master) or @Check[nature|dc:45] (legendary) to chart the meteor's trajectory, @Check[society|dc:50] (master) to recall information on Xin-Bakrakhan and how it was destroyed during Earthfall

disable: Ocean Lore|dc:42 (expert) or DC 45 Nature (master) or Survival (master) to chart the flood paths of the coming waves, DC 50 Crafting (legendary) to reinforce a shelter
routine:
(5 minutes) Only the first five minutes of this disaster directly impact the PCs, but during that time, they must contend with the combination of a megatsunami and meteor shower.

Meteor Shower: As meteor shower, but 7d10 Bludgeoning Damage damage and 15d6 Fire Damage damage to all characters (Basic DC 42 Reflex Saving Throw save). If at least half the PCs succeeded at Prepare checks, only one randomly determined PC is affected by the meteor shower rather than the whole party.

Tsunami: If at least half the PCs succeed on Prepare checks, they avoid all effects of the megatsunami until the last minute, at which point they're affected as if they were unprepared. Many of Xin-Bakrakhan's citizens are powerful wizards or otherwise have access to flight, be it by spell, wings, or flying minions, but their retreat into the skies above is chaotic. A PC capable of flight (or who is carried aloft by a flying ally) for an entire minute can avoid the tsunami's effects if they succeed at a Basic DC 35 Acrobatics check to Maneuver in Flight to avoid mid-air collisions with others or falling meteors—on a failure they're forced back into the dangerous waters below and take a –2 circumstance penalty to saves against the tsunami's effects.

The tsunami floods into the lowest elevation area on the 2nd minute, then proceeds up into the higher regions as shown on the map on each of the following minutes. A PC in the area is affected as the standard megatsunami, but (6d12+35) Bludgeoning Damage damage (Basic DC 42 Fortitude Saving Throw save) when they're first struck and then (4d12+25) Bludgeoning Damage damage (Basic DC 40 Reflex Saving Throw) each minute they're carried along by the wave.
